funnel_channel.sql:
SELECT channel, argMax(platform, n) AS platform, argMax(finance_channel, n) AS finance_channel,
  argMax(is_paid, n) AS is_paid, argMax(medium_group, n) AS medium_group
FROM (
  SELECT channel, platform, finance_channel, is_paid, medium_group, toUInt64(1000000000000) AS n
  FROM serve.dim_traffic_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.channel, t.platform, t.finance_channel, t.is_paid, t.medium_group, count() AS n
  FROM serve.session_funnel f INNER JOIN serve.dim_traffic_source t ON t.traffic_source_key = f.traffic_source_key
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
) GROUP BY channel

ltv_cac_daily.sql:
SELECT concat('o|', toString(brand_id), '|', toString(order_id)) AS row_key,
  brand_id, order_date AS report_date, lt_platform AS platform, lt_finance_channel AS finance_channel,
  if(lt_finance_channel IN (SELECT DISTINCT ad_platform FROM serve.ad_delivery_daily), lt_finance_channel, NULL) AS ad_platform,
  toUInt8(coalesce(lt_is_paid, 0)) AS is_paid, nullIf(lt_campaign_id, '') AS campaign_id,
  toUInt64(1) AS new_customers,
  toFloat64(if(lowerUTF8(trimBoth(coalesce(order_status, ''))) IN ('cancelled', 'voided'), 0,
    toFloat64(coalesce(net_revenue_excl_tax, 0)))) AS new_customer_revenue,
  toFloat64(0) AS total_ad_spend
FROM serve.order_attribution WHERE is_new_customer = 1 AND order_date IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT concat('s|', toString(brand_id), '|', toString(report_date), '|', ad_platform, '|',
  coalesce(campaign_id, '')) AS row_key,
  brand_id, report_date, ad_platform AS platform, ad_platform AS finance_channel, ad_platform,
  toUInt8(1) AS is_paid, campaign_id, toUInt64(0) AS new_customers, toFloat64(0) AS new_customer_revenue,
  toFloat64(sum(spend)) AS total_ad_spend
FROM serve.ad_delivery_daily GROUP BY brand_id, report_date, ad_platform, campaign_id

attribution.description: Pre-purchase touchpoints by order date: touches and orders with touchpoints, sliced by the touch's traffic source and its session's campaign.

commerce.description: Shopify orders on ORDER date: sales, discounts, AOV, payment mix, cancellations / returns of the orders, new customers. Slice by traffic (platform → channel → sub_channel, is_paid), campaign and geography.

customers.description: Customers with lifetime totals: customers, repeat customers, repeat rate.

funnel_orders.description: Funnel purchases and revenue per order (order date): the funnel mart's purchases sliced by the order's traffic, campaign and products (basket_*: orders containing the product).

order_pnl.description: P&L on ORDER date for performance and every non-Finance domain: COGS, contribution margin, net profit, ROAS / MER of the orders placed in the period (ad spend on delivery date). Slice by finance_channel and is_paid; drill campaign → ad set → ad. Finance (event date) is the pnl view.

paid_media.description: Ad delivery (Meta + Google) by delivery date: spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM. Filter ad_platform for one platform; drill campaign → ad set → ad.

paid_media_breakdowns.description: Meta delivery by audience breakdown (age, gender, placement, device, geo). Filter one breakdown_type.

paid_media_changes.description: Ad change log (status / budget / bid strategy changes), Meta + Google.

paid_media_hourly.description: Hourly binding of paid_media (granularity hour on report_hour).

pnl.description: Finance P&L on EVENT date (= dashboard): net sales, COGS, contribution margin, net profit, ROAS / MER. Slice by finance_channel and is_paid; drill campaign → ad set → ad.

product.description: Product performance on ORDER date (eligible lines): line revenue, gross profit, units, returns. Drill product_type → product → variant; slice by the order's traffic.

product_pnl.description: Product P&L: every order's P&L (order date and event date) spread over its product lines — net sales, COGS, operating costs, allocated ad spend, net profit, ROAS / MER, CAC and order counts by product, SKU or product type, sliced by the order's channel, traffic and campaign.

returns.description: Refunds by refund date: refund count, refunded amount, returns value, refunded lines and recovered COGS; drill to product.

unit_economics.description: New-customer LTV, CAC and LTV:CAC by day, platform (first-order last touch / spend) and campaign.

web_event_detail.description: Event-level web analytics (per page / product): events per session and event drill-through.

web_events.description: Daily web event counts by event type (page views, product views, add-to-carts, searches).

web_funnel.description: Daily funnel mart: bounce rate, Snowplow purchases and revenue by day and channel / platform.

web_sessions.description: Web sessions (Snowplow) by session date: sessions, funnel rates, add-to-carts, time to convert. Slice by traffic source and campaign.
